title: Explicit derived comparison with any injective resolution
statement: Let $v:A\to B$ be additive between abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], with enough injectives in $A$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $X\in A$ and any injective resolution $I$ of $X$, define $c_I:Rv(X[0])\to Q(EvI)$ by the chosen-resolution single-object comparison [lem-sp-derived-functor-single-identification], the quotient factorization, mapExtendIso, and the localized extension of the image of desc(id_X,I,injectiveResolution X). Then, in every degree $n\geq0$, $H^n(c_I)$ followed by the localization/extension homology identification equals $\theta_X^n$ followed by $I.isoRightDerivedObj(v,n)$.

source.place: Tags 014Q, 05TE and 015B: item proof Steps 1-4, fixed resolution triangle comparison before homology naturality

proof.text: Construct c_I as the stated composite, using a real lift desc of the identity, not a choice from an unproved existence statement.

Expand the single-object homology isomorphism and isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex. Use homologyFunctorFactors naturality and extendHomologyIso naturality. Expand the homotopy localization homology factor and cancel its inverse. Naturality of isoRightDerivedObj for desc(id_X) cancels the remaining chosen-resolution inverse. This calculation is fully proved in Lean.

theorem injectiveResolutionDerivedComparison_homology
    (v : A ⥤ B) [v.Additive] {X : A} (I : InjectiveResolution X) (n : ℕ) :
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor B (n : ℤ)).map
        (injectiveResolutionDerivedComparison v I) ≫
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors B (n : ℤ)).app _ ≪≫
        ((v.mapHomologicalComplex _).obj I.cocomplex).extendHomologyIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat rfl).hom =
    (v.homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso X n).hom ≫
      (I.isoRightDerivedObj v n).hom
